title: Without awareness, attention remains but its control fails

statements.text: If awareness is the control model of attention, then without awareness of an item, attention to it should still be possible, but its endogenous control should break down: it cannot be sustained, suppressed or shifted away on purpose.
statements.falsification_criteria: Awareness of an item is absent while the endogenous control of attention to that item is normal.

sources.quote: without awareness, attention should still be possible but should suffer deficits in control
If awareness of item X is compromised, and the endogenous control of attention with respect to item X is normal, then AST is falsified.
